scope: Public sources and images reviewed for an object-level picture of Hulda Garborg's exact personal bunad reportedly on display in the theatre foyer. No permission requests and no copies.

verified_identity.supports: Theatre explicitly states that Hulda Garborg's own bunad is exhibited in its foyer; its shown Anno Domkirkeodden photo depicts Hulda Garborg wearing a bunad, not a separately identified object photograph of the foyer exhibit.
Reconstruction studio states it visited and studied Hulda Garborg's original bunad exhibited at Det Norske Teatret. Its commercial photographs represent modern reconstructed versions.

reviewed_image_nearmisses.exclusion: Portrait of Hulda Garborg, not independently evidenced to show the exact physical object exhibited in the current foyer. 200x256 resolution. Do not label an artifact photograph.
Caption describes 'Bunad etter Hulda Garborg på Labråten i Asker', a bunad after Hulda at a different location; not documentation of this particular theatre foyer exhibit.

Modern documented Hulda-style costumes on mannequins at Slottsfjellsmuseet, Tønsberg, identified circa 1950; neither Hulda's personally worn bunad nor the separate foyer display at Det Norske Teatret.
